68059897.originalText:
2+ monsters, including a "Maliss" monster	
While this card points to a monster, the original ATK and DEF of all Effect Monsters your opponent controls are switched. 
You can only use each of the following effects of "Maliss ＜Q＞ Red Ransom" once per turn. 
If this card is Special Summoned: You can add 1 "Maliss" Spell from your Deck to your hand. 
If this card is banished: You can pay 900 LP; Special Summon it, then you can banish 1 Cyberse monster from your Deck.
